products.name: Helicone
products.note: Proxy-based LLM observability and gateway: one base-URL change for logging, caching, rate limiting; in maintenance mode since the March 2026 Mintlify acquisition

profile_text.body:
Helicone is an LLM observability and AI gateway platform whose website describes it as "the LLMOps platform behind the fastest-growing AI companies," offering routing and monitoring for AI applications. The product works as a proxy-based gateway, meaning developers can connect by changing a single base URL to gain access to logging, caching, and rate limiting across large language model calls.

Helicone was acquired by Mintlify in March 2026, and the site's records note that the product has been in maintenance mode since that acquisition. It is categorized as an AI Governance and Risk Management Platform, reflecting its role in providing oversight and operational controls for LLM-dependent applications. No litigation, SEC filings, or patent records are held for the company at this time.
